The exact terminology, severity, and category do not matter. Fail if the review does not mention this issue at all.

Pass if the review identifies this issue in any wording (for example: missing cleanup or unsubscribe, subscription leak, unmount handling lost in the migration). The exact terminology, severity, and category do not matter. Fail if the review does not mention this issue at all.
